title: Streaming replies
text: Pass any AsyncIterable or ReadableStream of text; Stop aborts the request through an AbortSignal, and Retry restarts the same message.

title: Safe Markdown
text: Headings, lists, links, and code blocks from a built-in subset. Model output is never parsed as HTML, and only http(s) links render.

title: Calm for screen readers
text: A role=log conversation that announces each finished reply once, never every streamed token.

title: Reads like a conversation
text: Avatars, times, and day separators that name holidays and non-working days from your business calendar.

title: Actions on every reply
text: Copy, thumbs up and down, attachment chips, and suggestion chips, all reachable by keyboard and reported as events.

title: Long conversations
text: Auto-scroll pauses while you read earlier messages, with Jump to latest; the DOM keeps a bounded number of messages.
